title: GFT UK is positioned on banking alone, serving tier-1 banks
content:
The UK entity of GFT is recorded with banking-only positioning aimed at tier-1 banks, and that is what excludes it. Banking is not itself a bad vertical for an append-only decision record — the opposite, since approval provenance is already a funded question there. The problem is the tier: tier-1 bank programmes are long, committee-driven procurements where a first design-partner engagement cannot realistically be placed.

As with several rows in this cohort, the tool column reads not researched, so the platform-level screen never ran. The exclusion is therefore positional only, and rests on segment rather than on stack or open-source posture.

Worth noting alongside this: the German parent, GFT Technologies SE, appears elsewhere in the same corpus as a Flowable partner holding Camunda Platinum certification twice over, ranked priority 3 rather than 9. The same corporate group therefore carries two very different verdicts depending on which national entity the row describes — a reminder that these screens are entity-level, not group-level, and that a do-not-pitch on one row does not close the group.
